facts.name: Duna sor
facts.inference: Informal fine search area: a small manually drawn inhabited street-context patch around the source name point and the northern Duna sor frontage. No independent municipal quarter boundary is asserted; overlap with larger quarters is intentional.

facts.name: Dunapart
facts.inference: A coarse central riverfront/cliff-belt extent using the actual road and river context. The long legal parcel sequence is not reconstructed cadastrally; southern industrial riverfront detail is outside this approximate central footprint. This is an approximate useful search extent, not the complete legal border.
